about: Pipeline register for the growth sub-score (track B). One row per project; 'pts' gives the points each study area gets from it under the rubric. Area adjustment = sum of its pts, clamped to -3..+5, added to growth before the 0-100 clamp (build_locations.py). Method + monthly search procedure: memory project_japan_house_compare.md and data/DATA_LOG.md item 13.

rubric.railNew: New line / new station / extension serving the area: opened within the last 5 years +3; licensed or under construction opening <=2032 +3, 2033-2037 +2, later +1; officially planned (route fixed in a government plan, no licence yet) +1
rubric.railCapacity: Capacity / reliability / faster-service work on the area's main commute line (longer trains, platform rebuilds, new stop of a faster service, new through-running): under construction or licensed opening <=2032 +2 (+1 if the line serves only part of the area); design stage or later +1
rubric.redevelopment: Station-front redevelopment or residential supply that changes the local centre (>= ~300 homes or a civic/commercial hub): under construction +2; city-planned (都市計画決定) or union approved +1; completed within the last 2 years +1; idea / study stage 0 (watch only)
rubric.newTown: New-town or cluster supplying >= 1,000 homes within ~5 years: +2
rubric.setback: Flagship project paused for years or cancelled -3; re-planned with a later date -1
rubric.centralWards: In Chiyoda, Chuo, Minato, Shinjuku, Shibuya and Toshima commercial redevelopment is constant background and is not counted; only rail and >= 1,000-home residential supply count there
rubric.until: Rows with 'until' stop counting after that month (opened/completed projects age out); pipeline_check.py lists them
